home.name: Christian Kirk
home.report: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Saturday that the 49ers may activate Kirk (calf) from injured reserve ahead of Monday's game against the Commanders, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

home.name: Mike Evans
home.report: Evans (ribs) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Washington, Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

home.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
home.report: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Thursday that the 49ers will "hold off" on placing Samuel (hamstring) on IR due to the team's bye in Week 8, Vic Tafur of the Athletic reports.

home.name: Demarcus Robinson
home.report: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Thursday that Robinson (ankle) has an "outside chance" to return from injured reserve for the 49ers' Week 7 game versus the Falcons but is more likely to be activated following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

home.name: Dre Greenlaw
home.report: Greenlaw's appeal of a one-game suspension was denied by the NFL on Tuesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

home.name: Nick Martin
home.report: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that Martin's (hamstring) status will be evaluated "in these next couple of days," Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

home.name: Garret Wallow
home.report: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that Wallow will miss "at least a couple of weeks" due to a hamstring strain, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

away.name: Stefon Diggs
away.report: Diggs (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against San Francisco.

away.name: Marcus Mariota
away.report: Mariota (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the 49ers, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

away.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
away.report: Croskey-Merritt (groin) has been ruled out for Monday night's game against the 49ers, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

away.name: Jeremy McNichols
away.report: McNichols (quadriceps) was a full participant in Friday's practice.

away.name: Jordan Magee
away.report: Magee (hamstring) was designated to return from injured reserve Thursday.
